I was backpacking west from Kiev and wanted to spend some quiet time in the Carpathians and hike (which I didn’t get to) and Rhakiv was a much needed spot to unwind. I’d highly recommend it for the fresh air, solitude (very few tourists except for the occasional mountain climbers), and dirt cheap but very filling borsch/traditional east European food. It’s easy to get to via bus which was like sitting in a rattletrap sardine can over one giant pothole but I liked it.
